data.text:
BLACK FRIDAY PROTEST

IN PHOTOS │Members of the women’s group GABRIELA stage a protest at Commonwealth Market in Quezon City on Feb. 13, calling for the removal of the 12% value-added tax (VAT) and denouncing alleged corruption that they say leads to the misuse of public funds. The group displayed oversized replicas of grocery lists and utility bills to illustrate how regressive taxes disproportionately burden the poor and the working class. They also urged the public to join broader anti-corruption actions, including the One Billion Rising protest on Feb. 14.

📸: Edd Castro
